body:
telemetry:
  reorder-window-seconds: 60
  buffer-capacity: 1024
  heart-rate-min: 30
  heart-rate-max: 240
  power-min: 0
  power-max: 2500
  cadence-min: 0
  cadence-max: 220
  swim-pace-min-exclusive: 45
spring:
  application:
    name: telemetry-ingestion-processing
  r2dbc:
    url: "r2dbc:h2:mem:///telemetry;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1"
    username: "sa"
    password: ""
  flyway:
    enabled: true
    url: "jdbc:h2:mem:telemetry;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;MODE=PostgreSQL"
    user: "sa"
    password: ""
    locations: "classpath:db/migration"
logging:
  structured:
    format:
      file: "ecs"
  file:
    name: "logs/telemetry-ingestion-processing.log"
  logback:
    rollingpolicy:
      max-file-size: "10MB"
      max-history: 14
  level:
    com.pulsestream.telemetry: "INFO"
management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: "health,metrics"
